description: This file contains the implementation of the ScorecardReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve scorecard data and associated values from the database, including mapping between database rows and Java data objects.

classes.name: ScorecardMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to ScorecardData objects; constructs SQL schema string for scorecards.

classes.name: ScorecardValueMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to ScorecardValue objects; constructs SQL schema string for scorecard values.

methods.name: getScorecardValueBySurveyAndClient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ScorecardValue objects filtered by survey and client IDs.

methods.name: updateScorecardValues
methods.description: Updates a collection of ScorecardData objects by fetching and setting their associated scorecard values.
